native_config:
model: deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro
architect: true
editor-model: deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash
auto-commits: false
auto-test: true
test-cmd: pytest -q
map-tokens: 2048
read:
  - CONVENTIONS.md
invocation: aider --message "<scoped task>" --yes-always inside a throwaway branch; one shot, no chat
limitations: Option names come from the aider configuration page. Model strings depend on the LiteLLM provider prefix and the v4-pro and v4-flash strings were not checked.
The editor model is also an author, so it must share the author family. It does here.
Latest release is v0.86.0 from 2025-08-09 with later commits. No MCP, subagents or sandbox. Never an orchestrator.
No install, load or dry-run was executed.
role_binding: Alternate for A03 and A06: scoped refactor or one-shot diff review. Architect and editor models both count as author or reviewer seats.

profiles.ultimate: Alternate for A03 and A06 on the pool shown.
profiles.b4b: Same with the cheaper rungs first.
